rationale: The previous candidate implemented recommended reductions in base_speed (0.8), ki (0.03), kp (0.6), and softened sensor_weights to [-0.5,0.6,-0.5], with line_loss set to 'search_left'. However, without telemetry data, we cannot confirm if oscillations and line loss improved. To further reduce potential overcorrection and oscillations, I have decreased the magnitude of sensor_weights to [-0.4,0.5,-0.4], as suggested. This should soften steering corrections and improve stability. I retain the other controller parameters and geometry unchanged to isolate the effect of sensor_weights. The observation request remains comprehensive to capture line_loss_events and steering_oscillation for diagnosis. I expect these changes to reduce oscillations and overcorrection, improving line tracking and recovery. Next telemetry will confirm if further kp reduction or other adjustments are needed.
